name: final_eval_session5_v1
decisions: Headline model B (A is the comparator); headline smoothing none, the live demo default. Chosen before any Session 5 result.
status_note: To freeze: fill dry_run_reference from a Session 4 dry run, set this to "frozen", commit, and rerun the dry run on that commit (it must pass). Session 5 then runs once. Freezing means no further model, preprocessing or metric changes; nothing is tuned after the run.
label_merge: exc counts as happiness; other IEMOCAP codes are unscored but still give B its previous-line context

B.text_input: the same speaker's previous Whisper line [SEP] current line

asr.note: The live demo's default (FAST_ASR, 4 threads). Whisper hears the first 6 s of each line, as deployed.

abstention: An empty transcript gets no prediction and counts as an error in every metric.

smoothing.scope: One state per speaker within a dialogue, updated on every line with a prediction, in time order.

metrics.change_accuracy: Accuracy on scored lines whose label differs from the same speaker's previous scored line in the dialogue.

excluded.visual: Face head runs at weight 0 in deployment and Session 5 has no visual cache.
excluded.mosei_test: Waits for the MOSEI source-identity gate in docs/async_multimodal_pipeline_roadmap.md.
excluded.msp_podcast: No MSP-Podcast audio is available locally.

disclosure: Session 5 is not a pristine holdout: older 11-class experiments (src/iemocap_baseline_training.py) evaluated it and selected epochs on its macro F1. The four-class models evaluated here were developed on Sessions 1-4 only. A's checkpoint epoch was picked on Session 4; B's recipe was chosen out-of-fold on Sessions 1-3.

dry_run_reference.note: From the first Session 4 dry run (2026-10-18, commit 83bcd44); they match the earlier live-settings Session 4 results. Later dry runs must reproduce these within the tolerance.
